role: The client world renderer: it owns the grid of WorldRenderer chunk sections, culls and sorts them against the camera, draws the sky, sun, moon, clouds, sunrise and End sky, renders all entities, draws the block damage crack and selection box overlays, and relays IWorldAccess events (particles, sounds, block updates) to the client effect system.
scope_reason: The C renderer reproduces the frames the pixel gates compare (SPEC 'Pixels: our own C renderer, matched against the oracle's software GL'); RenderGlobal drives the whole world frame.

notes: Member statuses judged against the native live render pipeline (raster.c raster_live_*) and the pixel-gated scenes under out/java/render/. The oracle-side determinism hooks (oracleSyncForCamera and friends) were added by the 14 hand edits and have no native names. Did not verify that renderEntities' entity ordering matches Java's within a frame beyond what the mob scenes gate. idxaudit 2026-09-27: missing entry added for playAuxSFX's client draws. lane/idxclient: closed against the oracle's frame pins (every dirty section rebuilt, every translucent section resorted, occlusion off); the remaining gaps are a zombie's door crack and the aux particles that draw from WorldClient.rand. lane/idxclient (later): playAuxSFX's 2002, 2003, 2004 and 2006 reach the frame only through spawnParticle and doSpawnParticle, which returns null for their names (iconcrack_, spell, instantSpell, portal, smoke, flame, blockdust_) when particleSetting is over 1 (RenderGlobal.java:2083-2120), and the oracle's options.txt pins particles:2 (Main.java particles, optionsFor): nothing is drawn; their WorldClient.rand draws only move the client world's Random (WorldClient's record). drawSelectionBox: the live box is the block's getSelectedBoundingBoxFromPool after setBlockBoundsBasedOnState (raytrace_block_bounds, the cactus's and cake's own boxes), not the constructor bounds (a fence between two others drew its post alone: idx-watch-s1 26 from 2,536 px to 559). renderEntities: a copy whose server entity left the world this row (an exploded creeper) is drawn once more, as WorldClient still holds it until the S13 (idx-burn-s1 52).
